Someone\'s not right in the heat
Check for danger before helping. Check whether they respond.
Call 000
This device can\'t open a phone app. Call 000 from any phone.

Call 000 now if they:

string-array.name: first_aid_call_now_signs
string-array.item: are confused or not making sense
are slurring their words
can\'t walk straight
have collapsed or fainted
have a seizure or fit
are hard to wake or not responding
have hot, dry skin or have stopped sweating

resources.string: Someone with heatstroke can still be sweating.
Cool them now while you wait. Don\'t leave them alone.

string-array.name: first_aid_cooling_steps
string-array.item: Get them into shade or somewhere cool.
Strip off extra layers, including PPE.
Soak their skin with cool water and fan them without stopping.
Put cold packs or wrapped ice on the neck, armpits and groin.

resources.string: If they don\'t respond:

string-array.name: first_aid_unresponsive_steps
string-array.item: Open their airway and check whether they are breathing normally.
Breathing normally: put them on their side and keep watching their breathing.
Not breathing normally: start CPR, ask someone to bring a defibrillator, and follow the 000 call-taker.

resources.string: Early signs

string-array.name: first_aid_early_signs
string-array.item: heavy sweating, pale or clammy skin
dizzy, faint or a headache
weak or can\'t keep going
cramps in the arms, legs or belly
feeling sick or vomiting
very thirsty or irritable

resources.string: Do this now
If they\'re awake and making sense.

string-array.name: first_aid_steps
string-array.item: Stop work. Move them into shade or somewhere cool.
Lie them down. If they feel faint, raise their legs a little. If they\'re drowsy or vomiting, put them on their side.
Loosen or take off extra clothing, including PPE. Wet their skin with cool water and fan them.
If they are fully awake and can swallow, give sips of cool water.
Getting worse, or not better within 10 minutes? Call 000.

resources.string: Anyone with these signs stops work, whatever the temperature.
Unwell but not an emergency? Nurse-On-Call gives health advice any time, day or night, on 1300 60 60 24.
